name: Oshikake Petit Lily
source:
A short Girl x Girl visual novel, where you come in contact with your crazily cute childhood friend.

Nozomi is currently recovering from clinical depression at home. Her eccentric childhood friend Puchiri comes to check on her, but their relationship may suddenly take an unexpected turn...

[Translated and edited from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/1144]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
一部短篇女孩×女孩視覺小說，你會與瘋狂可愛的青梅竹馬相遇。望未正在家中休養，努力從憂鬱症中康復，古怪的青梅竹馬普奇莉前來探望她，但兩人的關係可能突然發生意想不到的轉變……

[譯自並改編自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/1144]NovelGame[/url]]
